learning_outcomes.text: Student acquire basic knowledge of thermodynamics in the dimension of theory and practice. Student explains the principles of thermodynamics, heat-flow processes and issues related to energy conversion in technical applications
Student acquire basic knowledge of thermodynamics in the dimension of theory and practice. Student can set up a simple thermodynamic model.

syllabus_topics: Properties of ideal, semi-ideal and real gases
Gas laws, thermal and caloric equation of state
The second law of thermodynamics and its consequences
Simple conversion of energy, heat, work
The balances of power of open or closed thermodynamics systems
State and functions of state of ideal and semi-ideal gases and gas mixtures
Measurements of thermodynamic parameters: temperature and pressure
Determination of air and water enthalpy
Energy balance of piston engine and heat pump
assessment_rules: The passing threshold for both the tutorial test and the written exam is 60.0%. The tutorial test contributes 50.0% to the final grade, and the written exam contributes the remaining 50.0%.
bibliography: M.J. Moran, H.N. Shapiro, D.D. Boettner, M.B. Bailey, Fundamentals of Engineering Thermodynamics 8th Ed., Wiley, 2014
Y. Cengel, M. Boles, Thermodynamics An Engineering Approach, 8th Edition, Wiley, 2014
degree: Mechanical Engineering, first-cycle (engineer), specialization Design and Production Engineering
